newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 3.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The China Securities Regulatory Commission, the top securities and futures watchdog, has revoked the business licenses of 11 futures brokerages due to heavy debts and irregularities.
- Commentary says China's stock markets face new opportunities for development after Hong Kong's return to China.

- Finance minister Liu Zhongli said China's budgetary income increased 2.7 percentage points higher than expenditure in 1996, with a national budget deficit of 60.884 billion yuan, 558 million yuan less than the target for the year.

- BUSINESS NEWS - Growth of bank deposits in Shanghai fell sharply in the first five months of this year with new deposits being only around 700 million yuan against over seven billion yuan of the same 1996 period, partly due to two bank interest rate cuts last year.
